title: Guiding Light
summary: Wear to reveal Arcane Tower basement elevator controls. Also grants Light.

fields.Elevator: While equipped, reveals basement controls at the top and bottom Arcane Tower elevator panels.
fields.Light: Action in melee range. Shed light in a 25 ft radius. A character’s active weapon is lit until Long Rest; scenery and ground items receive 20 turns. One active target per caster. A hostile creature can resist with a Dexterity save against the caster’s spell save DC. Unequipping the ring does not end the spell.
fields.Acquisition: Recite the relevant Threadbare Book line to Bernard or defeat it and loot the ring.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
